title: Spurs return to leader of the pack
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 23

rankings.summaryHtml: They always get it going during the last 40 games of the season and it's happening again. A 5-0 finish would make the Spurs' finishing kick a tidy 30-10 this time. Over the past five years, Spurs' average finish is -- you guessed it -- 30-10.

rankings.summaryHtml: One loss, however disconcerting, can't drop them too far. Let's face it: Lakers are still a servicable 27-7 when all four of the future Hall of Famers play. That's a 65-win pace over 82 games, for what it's worth.

rankings.summaryHtml: Consolation prizes after Detroit stifled Pacers to make it a rare two-loss week: Indy needs just a 3-2 finish to be the winningest Pacer team in the club's NBA history, and a 4-1 finish to be the league's only 60-win team.

rankings.summaryHtml: Nice response to a crisis: Five straight home wins, including a victory over Houston on Friday to clinch just their second 40-win season since 1994-95.
rankings.summaryText: Nice response to a crisis: Five straight home wins, including a victory over Houston on Friday to clinch just their second 40-win season since 1994-95.

rankings.summaryHtml: To secure a 19th straight winning season, whether it makes the playoffs or not, Jazz just needs a 3-3 finish. But it's no lock, with roadies against Mavs and Wolves and home dates with Grizz and Rockets remaining.

rankings.summaryHtml: Didn't exactly respond well to the promotion, did they? We've been saying all along Rockets are a lock to get in, but they're not in yet, after losing five of six and eight of 11.

rankings.summaryHtml: Tough to watch without Kidd and K-Mart, but facts is facts: Nets have three straight Atlantic titles. Before this, Nets hadn't seen three straight winning SEASONS in the NBA since a stretch of four straight from 1981-82 thorugh '84-85.

rankings.summaryHtml: Besides the playoff streak, there's another streak on the line: Portland hasn't finished under .500 since going 39-43 in 1988-89. And losses at home to reeling Hornets don't help, with a rough schedule from here to the finish line.

rankings.summaryHtml: You know about the 0-7 start. You know we write about it every week. But did you know Heat can be just the third team ever to start 0-7 and finish with a winning record? The others are '82-83 Knicks and '95-96 Cavs.

rankings.summaryHtml: Here's another team, like gutty Denver, that showed us something when it had to. Bucks won the season series from Indy, finished the week with three wins and gave themselves hope of hanging onto No. 4 in the East. All while shorthanded.

rankings.summaryHtml: Besides injuries, what ruined Warriors' season is their inability to dominate the East like they did last season. They went only 14-16 against the East in 2003-04, compared to 19-11 in '02-03.

rankings.summaryHtml: One reason Coach Nate is frustrated is because he's not used to losing. Sonics have secured their first consecutive sub-.500 seasons since racking up three in a row from 1984-85 through '86-87.
